# Yes Bro

> The newspaper for your field. News, jobs, opportunities and research, every morning.
> No accounts required to read. No tracking of what you read.

Yes Bro is the first field-specific newspaper: news, jobs, opportunities and research for your field, every morning. No tracking.

Yes Bro publishes a free daily paper for each field. Every headline links to the original report. Readers pick a paper; there is no feed ranking and no tracking of what they read.

## Papers

## Yes Bro Daily

Yes Bro Daily is a free morning newspaper covering India and the world. It gathers politics, business, startups, climate and ESG, AI, health, space and science, and light humour, then writes short deadpan summaries with links to the original reports. Readers pick what they want without accounts or tracking.

- Home: https://yesbrohq.com/daily/
- RSS: https://yesbrohq.com/daily/feed.xml
- Keywords: India news today, world news, daily newspaper India, politics news India, health news, space news, AI news, climate news, humour news, Yes Bro Daily

## Yes Bro AI

Yes Bro AI is a free daily paper for anyone following artificial intelligence. It covers model launches, AI products, India AI news, funding, research papers, chips and compute, workplace AI, and safety and policy, with short summaries and links out. No launch-livestream fluff and no tracking.

- Home: https://yesbrohq.com/ai/
- RSS: https://yesbrohq.com/ai/feed.xml
- Keywords: AI news, artificial intelligence news India, LLM news, AI startups, GPU compute, AI jobs, AI policy, Daily AI news, Yes Bro AI

## Yes Bro Architecture

Yes Bro Architecture covers buildings, materials, climate-responsive design and green codes for India, plus architecture jobs, in a free daily paper.

- Home: https://yesbrohq.com/architecture/
- RSS: https://yesbrohq.com/architecture/feed.xml
- Keywords: architecture news India, green building, GRIHA, IGBC, architecture jobs, Yes Bro Architecture
